'''Platinum's Froslass''' (Japanese: '''プラチナのユキメノコ''' ''Platinum's Yukimenoko'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{adv|Platinum}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and her fourth overall. She was originally owned by [[Candice]], but was later {{pkmn2|Gift|given}} to her in ''[[PS413|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia III]]''. As of ''[[PS440|The Final Dimensional Duel X]]'', she is [[level]] 60, and her [[Characteristic]] is that she is "very finicky."

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
====History====
====={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}=====
======With Candice======
[[File:Candice Froslass Adventures.png|thumb|left|200px|Froslass under Candice's ownership]]
Froslass first appeared under [[Candice]]'s ownership in ''[[PS388|To and Fro with Froslass]]'', where she sent her out as her second Pokémon during the [[Snowpoint Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} against {{adv|Platinum}}. She first faced [[Platinum's Rapidash]], who was easily able to avoid most of Froslass's attacks. Even though {{type|Ice}} moves weren't very effective against Rapidash, Platinum had Rapidash heal himself with {{m|Rest}} just in case, only to be hit with a powered-up {{m|Wake-Up Slap}} from Froslass, severely weakening him. Froslass was then [[recall]]ed as Candice sent out {{p|Abomasnow}}. After Abomasnow had been defeated by [[Platinum's Lopunny]], Candice sent out Froslass once again. Even though Froslass seemed to defeat Lopunny rather easily, the Snow Land Pokémon was then defeated by a surprise attack from Rapidash, who had secretly been restored by Lopunny's {{m|Healing Wish}}, making Platinum the winner of the battle and earning her the {{badge|Icicle}}.

Froslass appeared again in ''[[PS398|Tackling Tangrowth]]'' during Candice, Platinum, and [[Maylene]]'s battle against [[Team Galactic]] {{tc|Commander}} [[Jupiter]] at [[Lake Acuity]]. Unfortunately, like their other Pokémon, Froslass wound up getting defeated. In Froslass's case, her downfall came in the form of Jupiter's {{p|Gastrodon}}'s super effective {{m|Stone Edge}}.

In ''[[PS411|Double Trouble with Dialga and Palkia I]]'', Froslass joined Abomasnow and the Pokémon of five other [[Sinnoh]] [[Gym Leader]]s' Pokémon during the final battle against Team Galactic at the [[Spear Pillar]]. Although the Gym Leaders were able to defeat the three Commanders and destroy one of the two [[Red Chain]]s that [[Cyrus]] used to control {{adv|Pokémon of myth|Dialga and Palkia}}, they were unable to stop the Temporal and Spatial Pokémon from fighting each other, and were subsequently defeated by Cyrus's Pokémon. As the Gym Leaders themselves were unable to fight anymore, they gave some of their Pokémon to Platinum, including Candice giving her Froslass to her. Unfortunately, a blast from the two [[Legendary Pokémon]]'s battle damaged the [[Poké Ball]]s containing Platinum's new Pokémon, preventing her from using them at the time.

====={{MangaArc|Platinum}}=====
[[File:Platinum Froslass Battle Hall.png|thumb|left|175px|Froslass in the Battle Hall]]
======With Platinum======
[[File:Platinum and Froslass.png|thumb|200px|Froslass and Platinum]]
After the crisis with Team Galactic had been cleared, Platinum's new Pokémon were seen being treated by {{Daisy}} in ''[[PS423|Tackling Togekiss]]''. After they had fully recovered, Daisy deposited them into Platinum's [[Pokémon Storage System|PC Box]]. [[PS426|Later]] Froslass, along with Platinum's other Pokémon, was sent to [[Stark Mountain]] to help {{adv|Looker}} and [[Buck]] while she challenged the {{gdis|Battle Factory|IV}}. After Platinum had successfully defeated [[Thorton]], Platinum's Pokémon returned with Looker and Buck, who had been severely injured while facing [[Charon]] and {{p|Heatran}} at Stark Mountain.

After the two men had been taken to a hospital to be taken care of, Platinum challenged the [[Battle Hall]] with Froslass. In ''[[PS429|Dealing with Dragonite]]'', after having made her way through an exhaustingly long streak of 169 battles, Platinum finally faced [[Argenta]], whose Pokémon was a {{p|Dragonite}}. Despite having a notable type advantage, Froslass still had a tough time battling against the [[Pokémon category|Dragon Pokémon]], taking heavy damage from its {{m|Steel Wing}}. However, thanks to the [[Babiri Berry]] Platinum had given to Froslass to [[held item|hold]], she was able to survive the attack and defeat Dragonite with {{m|Ice Shard}}, earning Platinum the [[Commemorative print|Hall Print]].

In ''[[PS439|The Final Dimensional Duel IX]]'', Froslass appeared once more during the battle against Charon inside the [[Distortion World]]. During the battle, it was revealed that Platinum's whole [[party]] had caught [[Pokérus]] through her three new Pokémon, powering them up.

====Personality and characteristics====
Having once belonged to a Gym Leader, Froslass is a well-trained and strong Pokémon. During the battle against Argenta, Platinum mused how she had originally faced Froslass as an opponent, but through the dozens of battles she went through with her at the Battle Hall, she came to know her a lot better. The two have a close relationship after battling so long together.
